rows.summary: 3 conservative atomic changes. Cash consideration to public figure: Material increase in disclosed cash consideration under the endorsement agreement. Restricted stock unit consideration to public figure: Material decrease in disclosed restricted stock unit consideration for the public figure. Brand ambassador service obligation: Operational change in the stated brand-ambassador commitment from a definitive obligation to a discretionary one.

rows.inferenceLimit: Do not infer actual cash paid in 2022 or 2023, realized cash flow, or pass-through to franchisees; this is the disclosed contractual amount. Do not infer that services were or were not actually performed; only the disclosed contractual wording changed from will to may.
